decisions.story_title: CISA adds six known exploited vulnerabilities to catalog
decisions.reason: Primary CISA KEV advisory naming six vulnerabilities added on Nov 10; no existing story covers this batch.

CVE-2026-111560.evidence: CISA added the Barracuda OS command injection flaw to KEV based on evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-111793.evidence: CISA added the Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder flaw to KEV based on evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-116606.evidence: CISA added the Barracuda ESG authentication bypass to KEV based on evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-124194.evidence: CISA added the Microsoft Outlook unsafe-action flaw to KEV based on evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-125350.evidence: CISA added the Google Chromium use-after-free to KEV based on evidence of active exploitation.
